items.title: Very close to identifying partner in India: Skoda CEO Klaus Zellmer
items.description: Skoda Auto is close to finalising an Indian partner as the Volkswagen-owned automaker seeks to reduce its dependence on Europe and accelerate growth in the world's fourth-largest passenger vehicle market

items.title: Colgate-Palmolive India bets on premium toothpaste as oral-care consumption remains low
items.description: Colgate said it is currently growing five times faster than competitors in the premium toothpaste market.

items.title: Torrent Gas to file updated draft papers for up to $418 million IPO: Report
items.description: India's markets regulator had approved Torrent Gas' confidential IPO filing in June

items.title: Godrej Industries enters private credit market with Rs 2,000-crore Category-II AIF
items.description: The fund has a target corpus of Rs 2,000 crore, comprising a base corpus of Rs 1,000 crore and a greenshoe option to raise an additional Rs 1,000 crore, according to the statement
